definitions.force_error: MTP minus PBE in the identical recorded laboratory frame; per-geometry RMSE = sqrt(sum over 27 Cartesian squared differences / 27).
definitions.original_primary: Combined force components over three central images, equivalently sqrt(mean of squared per-geometry RMSE) because each has nine atoms.
definitions.PBE14_primary: Mean per-geometry RMSE within each +/- physical block, then equal mean over four blocks, then paired Targeted minus Basin per seed, then mean of five seeds.
definitions.alignment: No force-vector alignment or atom permutation is fitted to reduce error. Ordered pair distances alone audit rigid-invariant overlap with 2.1e-6 A tolerance.

generator.interpretation: Perturbation around aligned-endpoint interpolation; not around relaxed NEB supports.

seed_robustness.scope: The ten seed Audit21 prediction arrays are not distributed in this subtree; no independent force/barrier recomputation of these ten fits.

original.geometry_scope: Ordered pair distances are rigid invariant. This is a qPT/OO projection finding, not an MTP feature-space extrapolation certificate.

definition.name: mean paired seed contrast of mean four-block transition-region force-vector-component RMSE
definition.per_block: arithmetic mean per-geometry RMS within the +/- pair; singleton out-of-plane as one
definition.per_region: arithmetic mean of four block means (one per selected physical direction)
definition.per_seed: Targeted-region-mean minus Basin-region-mean for same 64-bit seed
definition.across_seeds: arithmetic mean of five signed per-seed paired contrasts; show all 5 separately
definition.direction: negative favors Targeted at the chosen fixed 8000 cap

budget_arithmetic.interpretation: Arithmetic accounting, not a causal mechanism of optimization.

exploratory.scope: These sensitivity summaries are additional analyses and do not replace the locked primary endpoint.

Train119.scope: Frames and selected datasets are development diagnostics; saved gamma is re-thresholded, not independently recomputed from an absent live selector.

optimization.scope: Missing native states, A/r/D/transforms and process records prevent matrix re-solve, native parity or external-accuracy qualification. Decimal closure is not an independent native reconstruction.

training_logs.scope: Counts compare printed decimal objectives, not hidden optimizer state, convergence, or a causal decomposition of the force-error change.
